name: definition-change-not-on-boundary-from-previous-rule
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.2.0), rejected by the cross-block checks on exceptions.history, which run only when the definition has no block-level error. Without a transition the change point is from, and 2025-04-01 is not the first day of a 1 January year under the previous (top-level) rule. Only code and path are asserted.
